name: 7-Eleven Combined Distribution Center Lewisville TX (E.A. Sween Dallas)

fieldNotes.site: 1301 Ridgeview Dr, Lewisville TX 75057. Large multi-tenant flex/industrial building (north frontage carries Staples/Xerox/CPI/Bakery Express tenant signage). E.A. Sween operates the fresh-food Combined Distribution Center that serves 7-Eleven; its truck dock and refrigerated route-fleet drop yard occupy the east / southeast side of the building. Geofences cover that E.A. Sween operating footprint, not the whole park.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Black sliding/swing metal gate across the truck driveway into the SE yard, set between precast screen walls; confirmed in Street View pano gJ4XoG4YpHw35OFyMNGvOg from the eastern public street (May 2025).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth structure beside the gate in any Street View heading; gate is unattended.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present with no guard shack implies kiosk / call-box / app check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long bank of dock doors along the east building face with trailers/box trucks backed in; counted ~34 from overhead, banded 25-50. Door count is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: SE yard holds diagonal rows of refrigerated box trucks and trailers (route fleet) parked without tractors; 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated route-fleet / trailer storage lot on the SE, separate from the active dock apron.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Single dock cluster on the east face; could not confirm a separate ship/rcv bank.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 8.6 ac is the traced E.A. Sween operating footprint (building + east/SE yard), not the full multi-tenant parcel.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Lewisville / north-DFW industrial park; clearly Urban.
